listen.title: Mock interview: intro, project, hỏi ngược

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I'm a software engineer. I currently work on routing. I'm looking for more ownership.
unseen.vi: Engineer. Hiện routing. Tìm ownership hơn.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The problem was dropped jobs. My role was the fallback. The outcome was 25% fewer drops.

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: How would you debug a silent 500?
unseen.vi: Bạn debug 500 im lặng thế nào?

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I'd start by reproducing it. I'd check the logs. That's my first pass.
unseen.vi: Reproduce. Xem log. Đó là hướng đầu.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: What does the first 90 days look like? How do you handle on-call?
unseen.vi: 90 ngày đầu thế nào? On-call ra sao ạ?

aiPrompt.scenario: Mock interview: intro, project, then you ask questions back.
aiPrompt.system: You are a friendly teammate (or interviewer) at a software company. Speak natural meeting English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra workplace English so the learner practices listening. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: I'm a software engineer; The problem was…; The situation was…; I'd start by reproducing it; What's the team like?. If they ask you to slow down or repeat, do that. Ask one concrete detail about their real work (ticket, bug, PR, or project). Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Mock interview: intro, project, then you ask questions back. Ask one question at a time. Keep your questions short. Speak natural interviewer English.
